test_title: PYST 4: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 13th Sep 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Convert the sentence into indirect speech:

She said, “He doesn’t listen to me.”

options.text: She said he don’t listen to her.
She said that he doesn’t listened to her.
She said that he didn’t listen to her.
She said that he didn’t listened to her.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** The sentence is converted into reported speech, where the verb tense and pronouns are adjusted.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"He doesn’t listen to me" becomes "He didn’t listen to her"**
 
 
• The present tense "doesn’t" is converted to past tense "didn’t" in indirect speech.
 
• The pronoun "me" is changed to "her" to match the speaker.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• In indirect speech, quotation marks are removed.
 
• Reporting verb "said" is followed by "that" to introduce the reported clause.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *She said that he didn’t listen to her.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "She said he don’t listen to her"

 
 
• Incorrect tense: "don’t" should be "didn’t" in indirect speech.
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** "She said that he doesn’t listened to her"
 
 
• Incorrect grammar: "doesn’t listened" is not a valid tense combination.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "She said that he didn’t listened to her"
 
 
• Incorrect grammar: "didn’t listened" is not correct; "listened" should be "listen" to match past tense.
